messages:
maya: quick sync — can we align on instrumentation for reroute + synthetic probes for the regional dashboards? need per-region latency, cross-region failover counts, and traffic-split numerators/denoms. target: finalize API/metric names by EOD Wed.

sam-plat: +1. propose canonical metric names and tag keys so dashboards don't diverge. sketch: 
```
# histogram for latency
inference_latency_ms_bucket{le,region,zone,model,variant,host_pool}
inference_latency_ms_sum{region,zone,model,variant}
inference_latency_ms_count{region,zone,model,variant}
# failover/reroute counters
reroute_events_total{from_region,to_region,reason,customer_tier}
# traffic split counters
traffic_split_buckets_total{route,variant,region}
```
We should also emit exemplar labels for traces when possible.

aneli: histograms are great — Grafana panels should show p50/p95/p99 + bucket heatmap by region. For cross-region impact we need a panel with stacked failover counts by reason (eg capacity, az-down, policy) and a linked drilldown to recent traces.

kevin: runtime note — we can emit prometheus histograms from the C++ runtime (using hdr or prometheus client). mapping host_pool->zone exists in node metadata but we need a stable label key: use `zone` and `region` exactly. also add `route` label for top-level routing policy. KV-cache hits: `kv_cache_hit_total{region,route}` and `kv_cache_miss_total`.

product-analytics: add two derived metrics we need for cost/decomposition: `tokens_served_total{region,route}` and `compute_seconds{region,instance_type}`. Also need traffic-split numerator/denom to compute the effective split for each variant: suggest `traffic_split_requests_total{route,variant,region}` + `traffic_split_success_total`.

ops-sre: synthetic probes — plan: run 3 probe types per region: small (1-4 tokens), medium (~256 tokens), long (~2048 tokens). probes should emit `probe_req_duration_ms{probe_type,region,route,success}` and `probe_response_body_hash`. schedule: every 60s for small, 5m for medium, 30m for long. we will throttle for staging vs prod.

alicia: for console rollouts UX we need aggregated endpoints that return: per-region p50/p95/p99, failover_rate (failovers/requests) and traffic_split by variant for a route id. API contract idea: `/api/v1/route-metrics?route=<>&window=1h&by=region` returns a JSON blob. backend needs to pre-aggregate or the console will be slow.

sam-plat: internal API debate: do we push pre-aggregated rollups to metrics cluster (1m,5m,1h) or compute on the fly in the metrics service? prefer pre-aggregated 1m rollups per (route,region,model,variant) to keep Grafana fast. downside: cardinality — we need to cap by route sampling and route->tier filters.

maya: cardinality concerns are real. proposal: emit high-cardinality labels only for 1m rollup to dedicated metrics store, and a reduced label set for raw prom scrape. define `cardinality_tier` label: high for enterprise routes (dedicated), low for others.

devops-bot: deploy queued: runtime-metrics v3 -> staging. CI: 1 failing test (hdr-bucket) — will block prod promotion. :gear:

kevin: action items I can take: 1) PR to runtime to add zone/region/route labels + histograms (ETA Tue), 2) add kv cache counters (ETA Tue).

aneli: I'll draft Grafana layout: top row p50/p95/p99 by region, second row failover stacked, third row traffic split table + probe health. share mock by EOD Mon.

product-analytics: I'll add the derived cost queries and a sample notebook for per-region cost attribution. need sample data schema for tokens_served.

maya: summary of owners and deadlines: kevin -> runtime labels + histograms (Tue), aneli -> dashboard mocks (Mon EOD), product-analytics -> cost queries (Wed), ops-sre -> probe schedule + runbook (Thu). sam-plat to produce metric name list and final tag key set (Tue). we'll reconvene Thu 11am if needed. thanks. :white_check_mark:
